'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Israel Antiquities Authority]] finds fragments of the [[Dead Sea Scrolls]] in the [[Cave of Horror]], believed to be hidden during a [[Jewish revolt]] against [[Ancient Rome|Rome]] 1,900 years ago. In addition, a 10,500-year-old weaving basket made of woven flowers is also found. [https://www.haaretz.com/archaeology/.premium-israel-finds-new-dead-sea-scroll-first-such-discovery-in-60-years-1.9621317 (Haaretz)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-03-16/israeli-experts-announce-discovery-of-new-dead-sea-scrolls/100014230 (ABC Australia)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
*****[[England]] reports their first two cases of the new P.3. variant, which was originally detected in the [[Philippines]] and has been designated as a "variant of investigation". [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/coronavirus-latest-philippines-variant-cases-uk-b1818089.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania]]
****[[Lithuania]] suspends the use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] as a precaution following three reports of suspected serious adverse [[Thrombosis|thromboembolic]] reactions among vaccinated people in the country. [https://www.baltictimes.com/lithuania_puts_vaccination_with_astrazeneca_s_vaccine_on_hold_temporarily/ (''Baltic Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Russia]] reports its first two cases of the 501.V2 variant, which was originally detected in [[South Africa]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/03/16/russia-confirms-first-s-african-coronavirus-strain-cases-a73248 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in San Marino]]
****[[San Marino]] surpasses 5,000 people vaccinated and becomes the fifth country in the world in terms of vaccine administrations in proportion to its population. [https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/attualita-c4/vaccino-anti-covid-a-san-marino-5-430-dosi-somministrate-a202710 (San Marino RTV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]]
****[[Serbia]]n [[Prime Minister of Serbia|prime minister]] [[Ana Brnabić]] announces a five-day nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] from tomorrow until March 21, which will close all non-essential shops. Students in the lower grades of primary schools will most likely switch to online classes from March 22 for at least one week. [https://seenews.com/news/serbia-imposes-five-day-lockdown-to-limit-covid-19-spread-734635 (See News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****Emeritus [[List of Spanish royal consorts|queen consort]] [[Queen Sofía of Spain|Sofía]] receives the first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2021/03/16/6050ab9cfdddff11658b4616.html (''El Mundo'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****The [[Public Health Agency of Sweden]] temporarily suspends the use of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine pending a review from the [[European Medicines Agency]] following reports on abnormal [[Thrombus|blood clotting]] in [[vaccination|vaccinated]] people. [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2021/03/16/977731757/sweden-venezuela-latest-countries-to-question-astrazeneca-vaccine (NPR)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] reports a record 105 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,430. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50825536/worst-day-yet-ever-cambodias-february-20-community-event-sees-record-105-covid-19-positive-cases-announced-bringing-tally-to-924-and-national-total-to-1430/ (''Khmer Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Gujarat]] 
*****The [[Gujarat]] [[Government of Gujarat|state government]] decides to extend the curfew timing by two hours to 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. [[Indian Standard Time|IST]] in [[Ahmedabad]], [[Surat]], [[Vadodara]] and [[Rajkot]] until March 31. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/politics-and-nation/gujarat-to-impose-night-curfew-in-ahmedabad-vadodara-surat-and-rajkot-from-march-17/articleshow/81527526.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[Delhi]] reports its first two cases of the 501.V2 variant, which was originally detected in [[South Africa]]. The patient is a 33-year old man from [[Kerala]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/covid19-first-patient-with-s-africa-variant-confirmed-indelhi-101615873672590.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]]ese [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Yoshihide Suga]] receives his first dose of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech]] vaccine ahead of an April visit to the [[United States]] to meet [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]]. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/COVID-vaccines/Japan-PM-Suga-receives-COVID-jab-before-Biden-meet-in-April (Nikkei Asia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] resumes their [[vaccination]] rollout using the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine after it was temporarily suspended due to safety concerns. [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]] is one of the first people to receive the AstraZeneca vaccine. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/03/16/thai-pm-gets-astrazeneca-covid-vaccine-after-safety-concerns.html (CNBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts]], [[Lineage P.1]]
****[[Massachusetts]] confirms its first case of the Lineage P.1 variant that originated in [[Brazil]]. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/2021/03/16/metro/covid-19-variant-first-detected-brazil-confirmed-massachusetts/ (''The Boston Globe'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Guinea-Bissau]]
***[[Guinea-Bissau]] suspends the use of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine until May amid safety concerns regarding the vaccine, including fears about blood clots. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/amp/world/guinea-bissau-postpones-rollout-of-astrazenec-1195700.html (Urdu Point)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record 2,841 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 282,400. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-has-record-covid-19-deaths-as-new-health-minister-prepares-for-job-idUSKBN2B82TE?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Moderna]] begins testing its [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] in babies and children aged six months to 11 years in the [[United States|U.S.]] and [[Canada]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/moderna-is-testing-its-covid-19-vaccine-on-young-children-11615892416 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Integrated Review]], [[United Kingdom and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] announces that the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s [[nuclear weapon]] arsenal will increase from 180 to 260 [[warhead]]s, and that the UK will shift its foreign policy focus to the [[Indo-Pacific]] region, while remaining committed to [[NATO]]. The [[government of the United Kingdom|government]]'s review also identifies [[Russia]] as the "most acute threat" to British security. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-56413920 (BBC News)]
